observations: The full original review was replayed exactly once and equals the prior native result; original prescribed falls, reset mask, margins and timing bounds were not fitted to observed transitions.

Parent fixture input has falling-zero brackets at +4.860..5.173 ps and +4.851..5.164 ps from its two prescribed falls. Parent native clock falling-zero brackets are +109.237..109.549 ps and +70.183..70.496 ps. These internal observations do not create a new acceptance rule.

Parent release rising-zero brackets are +150.777..151.089 ps and +163.285..163.597 ps. Parent run has no zero crossing in either prescribed diagnostic window; its later rising-zero brackets are +390.778..391.090 ps and +411.722..412.035 ps.

After 2 ns, parent native-clock differential ranges from -88.143275 to +202.359862 mV, while parent run ranges from -183.101562 to +48.315065 mV. Zero-crossing delay alone therefore does not describe the observed signal behavior.

At the two parent original 62.5 ps deadlines, all four matched selector base differences remain negative: approximately -107.84 mV and -160.65..-161.30 mV, consistent in sign with the directly observed run pair at those same native rows. Values are observations, not a causal attribution.

Parent master has seven post-2 ns zero-crossing brackets; parent slave has none and remains positive at +36.455172..+163.225074 mV. Master-child fixture input is that exact parent-master pair. Q-child fixture input is the exact parent-slave pair, and its native clock, release and run have no post-2 ns zero crossing.

At the Q-child original deadlines, fixture input/native clock remain positive and release/run/selector base differentials remain negative. No missing Q-child release edge is inferred from an omitted signal: the exact native pair nodes, all global brackets and complete selected native rows are published.

All 318 original numeric HBT safety gates pass; the four previously failing parent tail minima remain close to the unchanged 0.4 V floor. The smallest current margin is 0.793372 mV at xdut.xd105. Different-capture extrema are not a same-time causal comparison.

The data identifies late and weak/sign-limited transitions in the conditioning/release/run observations and absent downstream input transitions. It does not establish which transistor, parasitic path or physical wire causes them, nor justify a geometry, circuit or threshold change.
